facts.fact: Vero 告诉 Brawley 昨晚遇到的女孩，就是 Clay 盯着的人，便利店的 paper-cut 对话让他整天想她
facts.anchor: I met a girl last night, the one Clay is stalking.

facts.fact: Vero 自称深爱 Brawley，母亲认为他对 Brawley 过于执迷，而他自己也承认
facts.anchor: My mom thinks I’m obsessed with him. I already know that is true—how could you not be?

facts.fact: Vero 强调自己的家庭很普通，父母婚龄三十五年，祖父母仍在一起；他并不认同别人把自己的性格归因于成长环境
facts.anchor: My parents have been married for thirty-five years, and my grandparents are still together.

facts.fact: Brawley 阻止 Vero 为测试纸割理论伤人，并指出正常人不会喜欢收到尸体当礼物
facts.anchor: “You know you can’t kill anyone just to test out that theory. Normal people would not appreciate being kidnapped and given a dead body as a gift.”

facts.fact: Vero 证实 Clay 昨晚先在酒吧盯着 Kayla；Vero 自己离开去买糖，随后在便利店遇到她
facts.anchor: I followed him into town, and he went to a bar. I watched for a bit as he stared at her, but I got bored and needed a sugar rush.

facts.fact: Brawley 提议请 Nixie 给 Kayla 发岛上邀请，Vero 吃惊他愿意为自己惹恼 Clay
facts.anchor: “Sounds like something he would do. This woman, should we ask Nixie to send her an invitation?”

facts.fact: Clay 问 paper-cut princess 是谁，Vero 终于说是 Clay 跟踪的女孩，并称她懂自己；Clay 直接否决
facts.anchor: “Fine, it’s the girl you were following. I want her. She gets me.”

facts.fact: Ares 告诉 Vero 自己或许想找一个能安定下来的伴侣，不像 Vero 想象的群体关系
facts.anchor: “Maybe I’m looking for the one,” he says as we stop at my bedroom door.

facts.fact: Vero 看出 Ares 对 Clay 的目光，也观察到 Clay 对非手足者封闭
facts.anchor: I see the way Ares looks at Clay, but our housemate is very closed off to anyone who isn’t one of his siblings.
